# Population
```{r echo=TRUE, eval =FALSE}
library("tidyverse")
```

```{r echo=TRUE, eval =FALSE}
pixy_to_long <- function(pixy_files){

  pixy_df <- list()

  for(i in 1:length(pixy_files)){

    stat_file_type <- gsub(".*_|.txt", "", pixy_files[i])

    if(stat_file_type == "pi"){

      df <- read_delim(pixy_files[i], delim = "\t")
      df <- df %>%
        gather(-pop, -window_pos_1, -window_pos_2, -chromosome,
               key = "statistic", value = "value") %>%
        rename(pop1 = pop) %>%
        mutate(pop2 = NA)

      pixy_df[[i]] <- df


    } else{

      df <- read_delim(pixy_files[i], delim = "\t")
      df <- df %>%
        gather(-pop1, -pop2, -window_pos_1, -window_pos_2, -chromosome,
               key = "statistic", value = "value")
      pixy_df[[i]] <- df

    }

  }

  bind_rows(pixy_df) %>%
    arrange(pop1, pop2, chromosome, window_pos_1, statistic)

}
```


```{r echo=TRUE, eval =FALSE}
pixy_folder <- "C:/Users/jc527762/OneDrive - James Cook University/PhD dissertation/Data/Chapter2_Genetics/03.population_structure_NEW/pixy_folder/pop/" 

pixy_files <- list.files(pixy_folder, full.names = TRUE)

pixy_df <- pixy_to_long(pixy_files)
``` 

```{r echo=TRUE, eval =FALSE}
pixy_labeller <- as_labeller(c(avg_pi = "pi",
                             avg_dxy = "D[XY]",
                             avg_wc_fst = "F[ST]"),
                             default = label_parsed)
```

```{r echo=TRUE, eval =FALSE}
# plotting summary statistics across all chromosomes
pixy_df2 <- pixy_df |> 
  mutate(chromosome =case_when(chromosome =="NC_067113.1" ~ "01", 
                               chromosome =="NC_067114.1" ~ "02",
                               chromosome =="NC_067115.1" ~ "03",
                               chromosome =="NC_067116.1" ~ "04",
                               chromosome =="NC_067117.1" ~ "05",
                               chromosome =="NC_067118.1" ~ "06",
                               chromosome =="NC_067119.1" ~ "07",
                               chromosome =="NC_067120.1" ~ "08",
                               chromosome =="NC_067121.1" ~ "09",
                               chromosome =="NC_067122.1" ~ "10",
                               chromosome =="NC_067123.1" ~ "11",
                               chromosome =="NC_067124.1" ~ "12",
                               chromosome =="NC_067125.1" ~ "13",
                               chromosome =="NC_067126.1" ~ "14",
                               chromosome =="NC_067127.1" ~ "15",
                               chromosome =="NC_067128.1" ~ "16",
                               chromosome =="NC_067129.1" ~ "17",
                               chromosome =="NC_067130.1" ~ "18",
                               chromosome =="NC_067131.1" ~ "19",
                               chromosome =="NC_067132.1" ~ "20",
                               chromosome =="NC_067133.1" ~ "21",
                               chromosome =="NC_067134.1" ~ "22",
                               chromosome =="NC_067135.1" ~ "23",
                               chromosome =="NC_067136.1" ~ "24",
                               TRUE ~ NA)) |> 
  filter(!is.na(chromosome)) |> 
  mutate(chromosome =as.numeric(chromosome)) |> 
  mutate(chrom_color_group = case_when(as.numeric(chromosome) %% 2 != 0 ~ "even",
                                 TRUE ~ "odd" )) |>
  filter(statistic %in% c("avg_pi", "avg_dxy", "avg_wc_fst")) 

pixy_plot <- pixy_df2 |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = (window_pos_1 + window_pos_2)/2, y = value, color =chrom_color_group))+
  geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5, stroke = 0)+
  facet_grid(statistic ~ chromosome,
             scales = "free_y", switch = "x", space = "free_x",
             labeller = labeller(statistic = pixy_labeller,
                                 value = label_value))+
  xlab("Chromsome")+
  ylab("Statistic Value")+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey50", "black"))+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "cm"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.placement = "outside",
        legend.position ="none")+
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0,NA))
  
png("pixy_plot.png", width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", res=300)
pixy_plot 
dev.off()
```
